newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Rubber Belt takes over Jiangxi plant.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Rubber Belt takes over Jiangxi plant.

text.p: Shanghai Rubber Belt Co Ltd has taken over a debt-ridden rubber products maker in the central China province of Jiangxi to expand its market reach, a company official said on Friday.
"The merger will bring us a wide market in central China and will help us to develop into the southwest and northwest regions," the official said.

"We don't need to pay any money for the merger, but we will be responsible for the factory's 37.38 million yuan of debts and 1,820 employees," the official said. "In return, we get the factory's total assets of 50.14 million yuan."
The factory, called Nanchang Rubber Products Plant, will be renamed Shanghai Rubber Belt Jiangxi Zhongnan Rubber Co Ltd, Shanghai-based Business News said on Thursday.
It is the seventh merger and acquisition completed by Shanghai Rubber Belt since 1989, the newspaper said.
Shanghai Rubber Belt reaped net profits of 8.2 million yuan in 1996 based on domestic accounting standards, down 17.9 percent from 1995.
An official said the company's 1997 target was net profit of 17 million yuan. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
